events.title: Shop Bulletin 4 - From the Desk of Bob

events.title: The demo is out — a full "early years" story arc, free
events.summary: The demo is now live, and it's a full "early years" story arc all on its own.8bit Salvage (the company - which is just Bob, Randy, and you) salvages pixels from retired game sprites. You hold a spinning brush over the art, the pixels come off one at a time, and they get sucked up through the hose. Your boss, Bob, walks you through everything, but not really.
